name: ios-ps-locale-yqs8va
goal: Under en_CA, the build can observe services before launch and retire only its own helpers.

evidence: Real macOS ps -o lstart= prints Fri 27 Nov under en_CA; a build must observe its services before launch and preserve its exit and output after helpers retire.
The completed-build example inherits runner locale. Exercise a day-first caller in that existing example and require the child to receive the caller locale.
